_comment: Skills packaged for upload to Claude chat (claude.ai > Customize > Skills). Built by tools/build_chat_skills.py from the pinned commits in manifest.json. Chat upload limits (Claude Help Center, 2026-11-12): name <= 64 chars, description <= 200 chars, ZIP with the skill folder at its root.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.description: Build distinctive, production-grade web pages, components and apps with bold, non-generic design. Use when asked to design, build or restyle a website, landing page or UI.

skills.name: theme-factory
skills.description: Apply a professional ready-made theme (colors and fonts) to slides, documents, reports or HTML pages, or create a new theme. Use when styling an artifact.

skills.name: canvas-design
skills.description: Create original posters, artwork and static visual designs as PNG or PDF, guided by a design philosophy. Use when asked for a poster, art piece or visual design.

skills.name: mcp-builder
skills.description: Guide for building high-quality MCP servers (Python FastMCP or TypeScript SDK) that connect AI to external APIs and services. Use when creating or improving an MCP server.

skills.name: hairline-create
skills.description: Create one interactive isometric line figure in the Hairline style, delivered as a single self-contained HTML file. Use for /hairline-create or a request for a Hairline figure.

skills.name: hairline-adopt
skills.description: Turn an SVG icon, logo or illustration into an interactive isometric Hairline line figure that answers the pointer. Use for /hairline-adopt or when given an SVG to bring to life.

skills.name: gemini-visual-generation
skills.description: Generate and edit images and make short videos with the Gemini Images & Video extension. Use for an image, post visual, story, cover, image edit or short video. Shows cost before any video.
